Seven moments · one story

Our Story before the next chapter

Not every important memory looked important at the time. Some were just a glance, a note, bread from a bakery, a quiet afternoon, a bus stop, and a laptop that needed fixing. In the end, our story led to our engagement, and from that moment our life began anew.

CHAPTER ONE

The First Glance

At Al-Husseiniya Basic School for Girls, one ordinary moment became the first page of our story.

CHAPTER TWO

A Small Note

A little piece of paper crossed the distance before either of us knew how much the story would grow.

CHAPTER THREE

In the Garden

2016

While I was arranging construction wood, you came carrying food. A simple afternoon that became part of us.

CHAPTER FOUR

At the Bakery

2018

Another ordinary meeting: bread, a warm bakery, and one more memory that stayed.

CHAPTER FIVE

Waiting for the Bus

2022

At Mutah University, on the Mutah University – Moab route, we shared the same place without needing to walk side by side.

CHAPTER SIX

The Laptop

2025

At home, the laptop needed fixing. Everyone was around, busy with their own little moment, while another memory quietly formed.

CHAPTER SEVEN

Our Engagement

2026

And after all those small moments, the next chapter finally had a date.
